WITH order_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    order_id,
    AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS REAL)) as order_avg
  FROM Order_Items
  WHERE product_quantity IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY order_id
),
baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(order_avg) as baseline_value
  FROM order_averages
)
SELECT 
  oa.order_id,
  oa.order_avg,
  oa.order_avg - b.baseline_value as difference
FROM order_averages oa
CROSS JOIN baseline b
WHERE b.baseline_value IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 
  difference IS NULL,
  difference DESC
LIMIT 10
